description: PAC 4º Balanço - Prevenção em Áreas de Risco is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Empreendimentos pertencentes a Carteira do PAC. Dados do 4º balanço do PAC, referentes ao mês de abril de 2012 e fornecem informações acerca de todos os empreendimentos presentes na carteira de projetos do programa. Eixo: Cidade Melhor, Tipo: Prevenção em areas de risco. Escala 1:2.500.000. Sistema de referência: SIRGAS2000. Coverage: Brasil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
